title: Cuando la IA también decide: el reto de definir las reglas
summary: El CEO de Oracle México plantea que la IA ya no solo analiza información, sino que participa en procesos de negocio y automatización. Argumenta que esto exige definir reglas claras de gobierno sobre qué decisiones puede tomar.

title: Oil hits $115 for first time since May as global stocks knocked by AI fears
summary: Oil hit $115 for the first time since May, and global stocks fell on twin threats of surging crude and doubts over the durability of the AI boom.

title: OpenAI Targets $1.25 Trillion Valuation in New Funding Round
summary: OpenAI is seeking about $30 billion in a new funding round and is now targeting a $1.25 trillion valuation, per Bloomberg. The news came as a rout in AI stocks faded at the end of a volatile week.

title: BASF Increases Bid for Chemicals Rival Evonik to Over €11 Billion
summary: BASF raised its takeover offer for German chemicals rival Evonik to more than €11 billion, per people familiar with the matter.

title: Blackstone Bet on Chips Drove a Debt Boom That’s Upending Credit
summary: Blackstone's bet on chips and GPU infrastructure, including CoreWeave, fueled a debt boom that is now upending credit markets. Executives initially questioned whether AI was real.

title: Infosys Lowers Sales Forecast After Companies Curb IT Spending
summary: Infosys lowered its annual sales forecast as companies keep curbing spending on major IT projects.

title: El Nobel que todo director debería leer
summary: Columna que retoma la frase de Mario Draghi en 2012 durante la crisis del euro como lección de liderazgo y comunicación para directivos.

title: DeepSeek Open-Sources AI Model as China, US Restrict Each Other’s Tech
summary: DeepSeek open-sourced a new AI model as China and the US restrict each other's technology. Bloomberg notes AI leaders want models everywhere yet under their control, and may not get both.

title: Anthropic strikes deal to launch European consultancy
summary: Anthropic and UK buyout group Hg are backing a new European consultancy that will advise companies on how to deploy AI. The deal expands Anthropic's enterprise reach through a services channel.

title: Shoprite, Investec Said to Discuss South African Fintech Tie-Up
summary: Shoprite, Africa's largest grocer, is reportedly in talks with Investec about a financial-services partnership to serve its millions of customers. It is a retailer-bank tie-up in fintech.

title: Winter arrives in markets
summary: FT says bonds and stocks are telling the same chilly story as markets turn wintry.

title: Europe’s largest landlord exposed to €8bn hit from Berlin apartment plans
summary: Vonovia, Europe's largest landlord, faces an €8bn hit if Berlin's winning parties compulsorily purchase 120,000 of its flats under their proposals.

title: AI oversight needs a different model to banking
summary: Financial Times argues that AI oversight needs its own regulatory model rather than borrowing from banking supervision, which was cobbled together over a century. The piece makes the case for scrutiny designed specifically for this technology.

title: Calpers retreats from Big Tech as AI rally falters
summary: Calpers slashed its Magnificent 7 holdings as doubts grow about lofty AI valuations and soaring spending.

title: AI Tech Fears Push Global Credit Spreads to 17-Month High
summary: Global credit spreads hit a 17-month high as an AI stock selloff and geopolitical tensions drove investors to safe havens. It is the biggest risk-off signal in more than a year.

title: Nu México advierte que el reto de los pagos digitales será la confianza de los mexicanos
summary: Nu México advierte que el principal reto de los pagos digitales en el país será la confianza de los usuarios mexicanos.

title: La Ley de Economía Digital habilita la CURP y el Expediente Ciudadano para apertura remota de cuentas
summary: La Ley de Economía Digital habilita el uso de la CURP y el Expediente Ciudadano para la apertura remota de cuentas, lo que facilita la contratación digital de productos financieros.

title: Regulador en México pone en la mira aceptación de vales de despensa en comercios
summary: La Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio investiga posibles prácticas indebidas en la aceptación de vales de despensa y medios de pago electrónico en supermercados y tiendas de conveniencia.

title: El peso mexicano se encamina a una depreciación semanal de 1.2% frente al dólar
summary: El peso mexicano se encamina a una depreciación semanal de 1.2% frente al dólar.

title: Alza de precios en seguros de gastos médicos mayores, principal motivo de cancelación, dice Condusef
summary: Condusef señala que el alza de precios en seguros de gastos médicos mayores es el principal motivo de cancelación de pólizas.

title: OpenAI trims valuation target to $1.25tn after pitching higher price
summary: OpenAI trimmed its valuation target to $1.25 trillion after pitching a $1.4 trillion price tag earlier this month, according to documents seen by the FT.

title: Regreso de comisiones bancarias y compra de más infraestructura para pagos digitales presionará el margen de gasolineras
summary: El regreso de las comisiones bancarias y la compra de más infraestructura para pagos digitales presionarán el margen de ganancia del sector, según el artículo de Expansión.

title: México da un controvertido paso para endurecer las reglas de las pensiones del IMSS
summary: México dio un paso controvertido para endurecer las reglas de acceso a las pensiones del IMSS, en un contexto de protestas por falta de medicinas y presión sobre las finanzas públicas para el Presupuesto 2027.

title: If AI displaces human workers, they will lose more than just pay
summary: The Economist argues that work has value beyond income, so workers displaced by AI would lose more than just their pay.

title: AI compute is the new oil—and needs a new market
summary: The Economist reports that financial firms are racing to create instruments to trade AI processing power, as compute is treated as the new oil.
